regime_hypotheses.rationale: Strongest outer-validation state contrast and largest conditional AUC spread.
Realized-volatility state separated weak and strong Stage-2 periods.
Volatility-of-volatility showed materially different conditional AUC states.
Trend alignment was one of the largest block-level state differences.
Trend strength showed a large block contrast and conditional AUC range.
Equal-weight relative leadership differed materially through time.
Volume breadth produced one of the largest conditional AUC ranges.
Credit-risk state showed conditional directional predictability.
Cross-asset crude state showed a large conditional AUC range.

statistics.development_candidate_rule: coverage >= 0.95; heterogeneity FDR q <= 0.10; best pooled regime AUC >= 0.55; best-regime moving-block bootstrap lower 95% AUC > 0.50; best regime has valid AUC in at least 2 outer folds
statistics.strict_abstention_rule: coverage >= 0.95 and worst-regime moving-block bootstrap upper 95% AUC < 0.50

methodology.threshold_source: Each development outer fold's training MOVE rows only
methodology.purpose: Require the outer-validation regime hypotheses to reproduce inside independent nested development OOF before designing a regime-aware Stage-2 architecture.
